note: `codeExtractNative` compiles `styled-components/native` and `@emotion/native` (part of #411): their `styled` (including `styled.View` and any other `styled.Name`) and `css` compile as Devup UI's with numbers as pixels, function parts receive `props.theme` from the runtime's `ThemeProvider`, and `ThemeProvider`, `useTheme` and `withTheme` import from the React Native runtime. Web output is unchanged.
